summary: Audit the schema-v2 lead-reconciliation migration while preserving existing search, metadata, and learned omission rules.

migration_audit.source_skill_or_workflow: Existing fjn-research-flow stage-gated survey workflow and schema-v1 manifests
retained_rules: Existing anchor, search-axis, frontier-audit, metadata, analysis, and final-report stages remain unchanged in order.
Existing InfiniDepth, 3DGRUT, NeoVerse, and other learned omission rules are preserved.
metadata.json remains the canonical full catalog and metadata.md remains its human-readable view.
Existing candidate classifications and method/platform boundaries remain valid.
new_hard_gates: Schema-v2 scouting manifests require named candidate_leads with source, relevance, and discovery_query.
Schema-v2 candidate admission requires exactly one admit/reject/merge/defer disposition for every normalized scouting lead.
Admit requires a candidate record; merge requires an existing merge target.
Schema-v2 metadata consolidation requires every admitted non-fit candidate to appear in metadata.json.
migration_audit.compatibility_notes: Schema-v1 scouting/admission manifests remain accepted with a migration warning, avoiding a forced rewrite of unrelated historical runs. Newly generated manifests use schema v2. The current shadow survey was migrated to v2 and reconciled without deleting prior evidence.
